scope.notes: OpenAI staff described it as a "manual reset for paid subscribers" performed by the Codex team "following recent service issues" — i.e. a one-off compensatory refill, explicitly "not a normal scheduled quota renewal". The community and the openai/codex GitHub tracker both refer to it as the "unified reset (June 4)". Mechanics: it did NOT top up on to the existing period — it replaced the quota period wholesale, granting a fresh allocation and discarding any remaining balance, and it moved the displayed weekly reset date forward.
